author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಭಗವಂತನಾಗುವೆಯೊ ಪತಿತರನು ಉದ್ಧರಿಸೆ
ಜಗಜನರು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ ನಡೆಯುವರೊ ನಿನ್ನ
ಮಗುವಾಗು ಕಲಿವುದಕೆ ಸಜ್ಜನರ ಸಂಗದಲಿ
ನಗವಾಗು ನೀ ಜನಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: You become godlike when you lift up the fallen;
then people everywhere will follow your lead;
be a child, eager to learn in good company,
and be a mountain for people, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Raising up those who have fallen is the most godlike act. Stay humble enough to keep learning from good people, and you will become a steady support for others.
